_comment: Ultimate Texas Hold'em locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[4x]', '[2x]', '[1x]', '[check]', '[c]', '[fold]', '[f]', '[skip]', '[s]', '[play bet 4x]', ...), the card labels/suits (e.g. 'A♠', 'K♥', '10♦'), the phase labels passed in {phase}, or any numeric chip/bet/payout amounts. The escaped literal '${{...}}' fragments in the rules pay table reproduce a pre-existing display bug verbatim and must be kept exactly (double braces are intentional).

_slots.{hand}: A comma-separated list of card labels, e.g. 'A♠, K♥', or the localized no-cards text
_slots.{phase}: The current phase label token (PRE-ROUND, PRE-FLOP, FLOP, RIVER, SHOWDOWN)
_slots.{actions}: A comma-separated list of bracketed action tokens, e.g. '[play_bet_4x], [check]'
_slots.{available}: A comma-separated list of currently legal bracketed action tokens
_slots.{cards}: A comma-separated list of card labels, e.g. 'Q♣, 7♦, 2♠'
_slots.{name}: A localized poker hand name, inserted verbatim
_slots.{net}: The net chip change for the round (may be negative)

player_prompt.rules:
🎯 ULTIMATE TEXAS HOLD'EM - Single Player vs Dealer

📖 UKUQALA KWE-GAME:
• Uqala ngama-{start_chips} chips
• Ideki elingaphandle (2♠-A♠, 2♥-A♥, 2♦-A♦, 2♣-A♣)
• Udlalela ngomdlali (house)
• Izimango zonke zifollow esitructura ye-Ultimate Texas Hold'em: u-post ANTE na BLIND bets, ufunde 2 hole cards, uthathe isinqumo mayelana ne-optional PLAY bets ngemiphase yezibetho, kusho konke community cards na ukulinganisa 5-card hand yakho eyohlukene na ya-dealer. Inhloso yakho kukhokha izimali zakho (unezandla ehlukene), ukupunguza izimbi zakho (unezandla ezihlukene).
• Game iphela unezama 0 chips noma ngaphansi kwa-start yomango (LOSS) noma ufake 1000 izimango nezama chips (WIN)

💰 ISTRUKTHI YEZIBETHO:
• ANTE: Mandatory ${ante} bet every round
• BLIND: Mandatory ${ante} bet every round
• PLAY: Optional bet during gameplay. Ngemdlalo, uthathe isinqumo ukuthi uyeke ONLY ONE yezi: (${ante4} if uyeke ku-PRE-FLOP, ${ante2} if uyeke ku-FLOP, noma ${ante} if uyeke ku-RIVER. Ungafaka noma uyeke ku-river, uthathe isinqumo ukuthi uthathe i-hand, uthathe bet yake.

🎴 UKUKWAZA KWEKARDI:
• Ufunde 2 face-up cards (hole cards yakho)
• Dealer ufunde 2 face-down cards (ezihlukanisiwe yakho)
• 5 community cards zikwaziwe face-down kwaqala
• Community cards zivuliwe kwa-mphakathi ngemiphase yezimango

🏆 UKUQULWA KWE-DEALER:
• Dealer kufuneka aqhubeke kwe-PAIR (2 cards zesikhundla sama)
• Ukufika kwe-dealer kwenza uthathe izimbi, kuzohlukahluka ngokuthi kwenze njani.

🎮 IZIMANGO NE-ACTIONS:
📋 PRE-FLOP:
  • Izinselelo: [4x] (${ante4}) noma [check]
  • [4x]: Thatha ${ante4} PLAY bet, vula community cards ezintathu zokuqala
  • [check]: Awunambitho, vula community cards ezintathu zokuqala

📋 FLOP:
  • I-4x bet ikhishwe: Inqaku [skip] (auto-reveals last 2 community cards)
  • I-4x bet ayikho: [2x] (${ante2}) noma [check]
  • [2x]: Thatha ${ante2} PLAY bet, vula community cards ezimbili ezisapho
  • [check]: Awunambitho, vula community cards ezimbili ezisapho

📋 RIVER:
  • I-4x noma 2x bet ikhishwe: Inqaku [skip] (auto-proceeds ku-showdown)
  • I-PLAY bet ayikho: [1x] (${ante}) noma [fold]
  • [1x]: Thatha ${ante} PLAY bet, ya ku-showdown
  • [fold]: Thatha isinqumo ukuthi uthathe i-hand, uthathe ANTE na BLIND bets

📋 SHOWDOWN:
  • Konke cards zivuliwe nezihlanganisiwe
  • 5-card hand ezihlezi zithathwe (2 hole + 5 community)
  • Izibetho zithathelwe ngokulingana nezimbi

💎 IZIBETHO ZEZIMALI:
📊 ANTE BET:
  • Dealer ayikwazi: PUSH (bet ithunyelwe)
  • Dealer ikwazi & uwin: 1:1 payout (bet + izimali)
  • Dealer ikwazi & ulose: Bet ilahleka
  • Tie: PUSH (bet ithunyelwe)

📊 BLIND BET:
  • Ayibangi kwe-dealer qualification
  • Uwin: Bet ithunyelwe na izimali ezithunyelwe
  • Ulose: Bet ilahleka
  • Tie: PUSH (bet ithunyelwe)

📊 BLIND BET PAY TABLE:
  • Royal Flush: 500:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 500}})
  • Straight Flush: 50:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 50}})
  • Four of a Kind: 10:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 10}})
  • Full House: 3:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 3}})
  • Flush: 3:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 3}})
  • Straight: 1:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 1}})
  • Less than Straight: Awunambitho

📊 PLAY BET:
  • Ayibangi kwe-dealer qualification
  • Ukulinganisa okuthula: 5-card hand yakho vs Dealer's 5-card hand
  • Uwin: 1:1 payout (bet + izimali)
  • Ulose: Bet ilahleka
  • Tie: PUSH (bet ithunyelwe)

🎯 UKULINGANISA KWE-POKER HAND (Best to Worst):
  1. Royal Flush: A-K-Q-J-10 sama suit
  2. Straight Flush: 5 consecutive cards sama suit
  3. Four of a Kind: 4 cards sama rank
  4. Full House: 3 of a kind + 2 of a kind
  5. Flush: 5 cards sama suit
  6. Straight: 5 consecutive cards
  7. Three of a Kind: 3 cards sama rank
  8. Two Pair: 2 pairs zezikhundla ezahlukene
  9. One Pair: 2 cards sama rank
  10. High Card: I-card ephakeme inika

⌨️  IZINSELELO ZEZENZO:
• [4x] noma [play bet 4x]: Thatha ${{self.ante_amount*4}} PLAY bet
• [2x] noma [play bet 2x]: Thatha ${{self.ante_amount*2}} PLAY bet
• [1x] noma [play bet 1x]: Thatha ${{self.ante_amount*1}} PLAY bet
• [check] noma [c]: Check (awunambitho)
• [fold] noma [f]: Fold (uthathe isinqumo ukuthi uthathe i-hand)
• [skip] noma [s]: Skip to next phase (when no action needed)

💡 IZINSELELO ZEZENZO:
• Izandla ezikhulu (pairs, high cards) zithatha 4x bets
• Fika kwe-dealer qualification - izandla ezincane zingapusha kwe-dealer ayikwazi
• BLIND bet inaweza kuwa na-mali (Royal Flush = 500:1!)
• Buka i-chip stack yakho! I-chip stack yakho iyaphela 0 noma ngaphansi kwa-start yomango, uyalahla.

⚠️  AMANOTI AFANAKAYO:
• ANTE na BLIND bets zikhona mandatorily every round
• PLAY bets zikhona optional na strategic
• Hlala uthathe isinqumo ukuthi uthathe i-action, na only one action at a time.
